name: A measured rhythm is the one the arrivals keep
says: measured on the instances RFC 5545 lists for its recurrence examples, a rule with one period gives that period and its next instance exactly, and a claimed rhythm rarely misses the next instance; a season's end (every day in January) cannot be foreseen from the days before it

measures.says: moments in the listings of single-period RFC 5545 rules and weekly rules by weekday, with three cycles held, where the measured rhythm is not the rule's own or its next is not the listed next
share of claimed rhythms over every RFC 5545 listing whose next instance is further than a tenth of the period from the listed next
